ios.desc:
Tired of never finishing an anime series?

Welcome to AniShort - Where Animation Meets Short-Form Entertainment!

Experience the future of short-form anime with AniShort, the next-gen platform that delivers bite-sized, vertical anime episodes in an exciting new format. Each 2-minute anime short is packed with action, drama, and stunning animation—perfect for your spare time!

---

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ANISHORT

UNIQUE VIEWING EXPERIENCE
• Short anime, donghua and animated webtoons optimized for your phone
• High-quality animation and stunning artwork
• Scroll through quick 1-2 minute episodes, ideal for on-the-go entertainment

EXCLUSIVE CONTENT
• Original short anime series created specifically for mobile viewing
• Dubbed and animated manhwa and webtoons — enjoy your favorite stories in animated form!
• Daily updates with new shows and episodes
• Multiple genres: Shonen, Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Romance, Drama, Slice of Life, Horror, Thriller, Mecha, GL, BL, Yaoi, LGBTQ+, and more
• Animations available in both subbed and dubbed formats
• Adaptations of top webcomics, webtoons, manga, manhwa, manhua, fiction, and novels from Tapas, Manta, Wattpad, GoodNovel, WebNovel, Galatea, AO3, and more

FEATURED SERIES
• I'm The Strongest Boss, Stop Sending Noobs - Action, Fantasy, Shonen
• I’m the Last Place Witch - Romance, Fantasy, Magic
• Reborn as My Enemy’s Servant - Action, Shonen, Power Fantasy
• Falling for My Public Scandal Girlfriend - Romance, Drama, GL, LGBTQ+

PREMIUM FEATURES
• Binge watch full short anime series
• Ad-free viewing experience
• Early access to the newest anime shorts

COMMUNITY & SOCIAL
• Comment on episodes and rate series
• Follow your favorite anime shows and creators
• Join discussions on trending anime shorts

---

DISCOVER THE BEST SHORT ANIME ON ANISHORT

• Trending Now - Top anime shorts and animated webtoons
• Best of Each Genre - Shonen, Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Romance, Drama, Slice of Life, Horror, Thriller, Shoujo, GL, BL, Yaoi & more
• Hidden Gems - Must-watch short anime shows and motion comics
• Complete Series - Full collections of anime shorts

---

Download AniShort now and revolutionize your entertainment experience!
Join fans around the world already enjoying the perfect blend of anime, donghua, and animated webtoons in convenient, bite-sized episodes.
